headline: President Obama assigned duties under a 2015 trade law to specific federal officials and agencies.
what_it_does: This order hands off certain powers and tasks that the Trade Facilitation and Trade Enforcement Act of 2015 gave to the President. It assigns them to other federal officials or agencies so they can carry out the law. The title does not say which officials or which tasks are involved.

who_it_affects.how: They are given responsibility for carrying out certain parts of the 2015 trade law on the President's behalf.

when_it_takes_effect: 2016-07-22 (date signed; exact effective date not stated in the source)
